name_zh: 汤加/波利尼西亚君主制：君主立宪与族群现代化
name_en: Tonga/Polynesian Monarchy: Constitutional Monarchy & Clan Modernization
description_zh: 汤加图普一世 (1797-1893) 统一/1875 宪法/波利尼西亚唯一君主制/图普六世 (1959-) 2012- 执政/2010 政治改革/议会民主/贵族/平民/土地不可买卖/侨民汇款/气候/深海矿产/太平洋论坛。核心模式：波利尼西亚君主立宪 — 君主/贵族/平民/土地/教会/宪法/改革/传统/现代平衡。体现 M206 波利尼西亚君主立宪 — 以"君主制合法性+贵族制衡+土地托管+侨民经济"四位一体，在君主制/民主/族群/气候四重张力中实现波利尼西亚唯一君主制现代化。
description_en: Tonga Tupou I (1797-1893) unified/1875 Constitution/Polynesia's only monarchy/Tupou VI (1959-) 2012- reigns/2010 political reform/parliamentary democracy/nobles/commoners/land inalienable/diaspora remittances/climate/deep sea minerals/Pacific Forum. Core model: Polynesian Constitutional Monarchy — monarch/nobles/commoners/land/church/constitution/reform/tradition/modernity balance. Exemplifies M206 Polynesian Constitutional Monarchy — quaternity of 'monarchical legitimacy + noble checks + land trusteeship + diaspora economy' achieving Polynesia's only monarchy modernization amid quadruple tensions of monarchy/democracy/clan/climate.
reason_zh: 汤加非单纯君主制，而是"君主+贵族+土地托管"三位一体波利尼西亚特色政体。1875 宪法确立君主/贵族/平民三权分立，土地不可买卖由贵族托管，侨民汇款支撑经济。M206 区隔于 M205 法阿马泰(萨摩亚)、M187 酋长制(加纳)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"君主制即传统合法性+贵族即制衡机制+土地托管即主权保障"的波利尼西亚君主立宪范式。
reason_en: Tonga not mere monarchy but 'monarch + nobles + land trusteeship' trinity Polynesian characteristic polity. 1875 Constitution established monarch/nobles/commoners separation of powers, land inalienable held by nobles in trust, diaspora remittances sustain economy. M206 distinct from M205 Fa'amatai (Samoa), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'monarchy as traditional legitimacy + nobles as check mechanism + land trusteeship as sovereignty guarantee' Polynesian constitutional monarchy paradigm.
steps_zh: 君主制传统合法性：图普一世统一/1875 宪法/基督教/西方/传统融合/君主即国家/图普六世延续
贵族制衡与 2010 改革：33 贵族/议会席位/平民选举/首相/内阁/权力下放/民主化/君主礼仪化
土地托管与主权保障：全境土地贵族托管/不可买卖/租赁/平民使用权/外资禁入/主权/粮食/文化/生态四重保障
侨民汇款经济支柱：5万+ 侨民/新西兰/澳洲/美国/汇款 40%+ GDP/季节工/技能/教育/家庭/国家生存线
气候适应与深海未来：海平面/珊瑚/台风/搬迁/适应基金/深海矿产/专属经济区/太平洋论坛/大国平衡
steps_en: Monarchical traditional legitimacy: Tupou I unified/1875 Constitution/Christian/Western/tradition fusion/monarch = state/Tupou VI continues
Noble checks & 2010 reform: 33 nobles/parliament seats/commoner elections/PM/cabinet/power devolution/democratization/monarch ceremonial
Land trusteeship & sovereignty guarantee: all land nobles trusteeship/inalienable/lease/commoner use rights/foreign capital banned/sovereignty/food/culture/ecology quadruple guarantee
Diaspora remittance economic pillar: 50k+ diaspora/NZ/AUS/US/remittances 40%+ GDP/seasonal workers/skills/education/families/national lifeline
Climate adaptation & deep sea future: sea level/coral/cyclones/relocation/adaptation funds/deep sea minerals/EEZ/Pacific Forum/great power balance
expected_zh: 以"君主合法性+贵族制衡+土地托管+侨民经济"四位一体，在君主制/民主/族群/气候四重张力中实现波利尼西亚唯一君主制现代化，为太平洋君主制提供现代化范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'monarchical legitimacy + noble checks + land trusteeship + diaspora economy' achieves Polynesia's only monarchy modernization amid quadruple tensions of monarchy/democracy/clan/climate, providing modernization paradigm for Pacific monarchies.
